component.name: Capy Canvas
component.summary: Draw and paint with a GPU-accelerated canvas

description.p: Capy Canvas is an app for sketching, illustration and photography, with GPU-accelerated brushes and compositing, layers and photo adjustments.

ul.li: The Windows uninstaller is signed, like the app and its setup program.

description.p: The first public beta of Capy Canvas, for Linux, Windows, macOS, iPad, Android tablets and the web.

ul.li: Enclose and Fill, under Lasso Fill, fills the empty areas inside a loop you draw.
Edit Color has a new layout on Windows, macOS and iPad, with color values you can type, drag to adjust and copy.
On macOS and iPad, tap a color fill's thumbnail, Paper included, to change its color.
Layer thumbnails have rounded corners everywhere, and filters use the same effects icon throughout.
Windows reopens all your windows at launch and asks about any drawing it could not restore.
The Windows color wheel stays smooth while panels resize, and Export Preview on Windows works again.
The Windows app and setup program are signed, and the Mac app is notarized by Apple.
